_comment: THUGPRO compatibility for the THUG1 level ports (tools/thug1_levels). Each entry is registered in README.md here (TP-30 level_names, TP-31 spawns, TP-32 ... TP-39 THUGPRO's other hand edits: moved_nodes, net_presence, created_at_start, node_values, rails, face_values, collision_removed, collision_reshaped - their form: tools/thug1_levels/hand_edits.ts). spawns and TP-32 ... TP-39 are written by `node tools/thug1_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro`, never by hand. Online a level is known only by its load script's checksum (messages 0x46 / 0x33). The other THUG1 levels are named by THUG1's own Levels.qb (Load_NJ...) - THUG1 data, no entry. Read by tools/compat/compat.ts; `thug1_levels.ts convert --compat none` leaves all of it out but port_changes (ours, not THUGPRO's). thugpro_new (TPN-THUG1-1 ... 4): what is new in THUGPRO, by reference (README: New in THUGPRO); port_changes (PC-THUG1-n): our own changes (README: Our own changes).

spawns._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx node arrays against THUG1's own, extracted by `node tools/thug1_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (pos = THUG2's Pos axes; order: every Multiplayer / Horse / CTF / Team restart in THUGPRO's order, by THUG1's names)

moved_nodes._source: nodes THUGPRO moved: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx node arrays and <level>col.prx collision against THUG1's own, extracted by `node tools/thug1_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (thugpro_edits.handEdits; never typed in)

thugpro_new._comment: NEW in THUGPRO - content THUGPRO made that is in no source game (the user's decision 2026-10-20, with Morten's agreement): BY REFERENCE ONLY - references and checksums of THUGPRO's files, read from the user's THUGPRO install when converting (--thugpro), never their bytes. Written by `node tools/thug1_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (thugpro_new.extract); its form: tools/thug1_levels/thugpro_new.ts. --no-thugpro-new or --compat none leave it out.

port_changes._comment: Our own changes to THUG1's levels (PC-THUG1-1 ...): what tools/thug1_levels does that comes neither from THUG1 nor from THUGPRO (tools/thug1_levels/port_changes.ts; README.md here, "Our own changes (port_changes)"). Read whatever --compat says; --no-port-changes switches off every entry that isn't required (required: needed for THUG2 to load the level or to avoid a crash). Each entry: id, op (add / set / remove), target, why, required.

entries.target: every kill script without nodename= (SK3_KillSkater...): nodename= the restart nearest its first trigger node
entries.why: THUG2 leaves the skater dead without a restart to put it back at (THUG1 Hawaii's pool)

entries.target: a level with no Multiplayer restart (THUG1 DJ, PH, SC...): its Player1 restarts also Multiplayer and Horse
entries.why: a network game needs spawns; these were single-player levels in THUG1

entries.target: the first Player1 restart moved to the node array's start (Links follow; not where TP-31 orders the spawns)
entries.why: THUG2 starts a free skate at the array's first player restart

entries.target: a trigger script that only calls DuplicateTrigger: replaced by the linked node's trigger script
entries.why: our script translator can't see THUG2's SkaterGap DuplicateTrigger member, so the gap would be lost

entries.target: restarts over nothing or over a kill zone's trigger faces: no network spawn; kills sending there sent to the nearest grounded restart
entries.why: a spawn or a kill there leaves the skater under the world
THUG2's ped AI plays human animations: an animal's skeleton crashes it (0x00482BA0)

entries.target: GenericNodes other than KOTH crowns (THUG1's goal nodes)
entries.why: THUG2 can't run THUG1's goals; whether THUG2 copes with their nodes is untested - kept on

entries.target: vehicles / game objects whose model THUG2 hasn't, or whose skeleton THUG2 doesn't load (Old Skool icons, goal pick-ups...)
entries.why: a missing model or skeleton crashes making the object (0x004A3D30)

entries.target: particle objects whose texture THUG2 hasn't; moving objects (LevelObjects) without a scene sector
entries.why: nothing to draw them with: a null in THUG2

entries.target: peds: THPS5_human -> THPS6_human skeleton and animations, a THUG2 profile when THUG1's isn't THUG2's
entries.why: THUG1's skeleton's animations aren't loaded in THUG2

entries.target: node keys naming what THUG2 hasn't: SoundType, AnimName / Extra_Anims
entries.why: THUG2 looks them up and reads through a null

entries.target: TrickObject / Cluster on climbing nodes and on geometry without a scene sector
entries.why: ParseNodeArray (0x00588630) registers the cluster's sector without checking it

entries.target: rail / node TerrainType THUG2 hasn't: a THUG2 terrain (nodes.fixTerrains)
entries.why: THUG2 reads through a null for a terrain its table hasn't

entries.target: path followers, peds and cars: AbsentInNetGames
entries.why: no path manager or ped animations in network games: a crash

entries.target: script statements THUG2 can't run (goals, cutscenes, THUG1's flags, sounds THUG2 hasn't...) and trigger scripts not brought along
entries.why: THUG1's goal manager and flags aren't THUG2's (GetFlag of a THUG1 flag crashed Manhattan)

entries.target: GetGap / Gap_CarHop given their gap script; the models' gap / trick scripts defined empty
entries.why: the loader's gap scan reads through a null for a gap script that isn't there

entries.target: the node array's shared parts made global structures (<level>_inc_n)
entries.why: expanded, THUG1's node arrays run THUG2 out of script components while loading

entries.target: restart_types from a restart's Type; THUG1's kill scripts as THUG2's SK3_KillSkater(_Water)
entries.why: THUG2's restarts and kills are looked up so

entries.target: a level THUG2 has the name of (SC, DJ, PH, TestLevel, the shops): named thug1_<code>
entries.why: Levels.qb would replace THUG2's own level

entries.target: collision face flags 0x2000 / 0x4000 / 0x8000; skinned scene sectors
